name: Moe Wars: Golden Daisy
source:
Devil Corp is holding tournaments to test out their new nanobots known as REN. These nanobots can protect users from harm, spawn weapons, and even give them supernatural powers. Nina gets a job offer from them to be a guard while they hold the tournaments. The pay is good, but she’s not sure if she wants to leave her best friend June. What if something happens to her?

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/moe-wars-golden-daisy]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
